How to Remove Acrylic Paint from Your Carpet.

First, spill acrylic paint on your carpet. Just kidding, don't do that. But if you do, this is how you fix it. Take a white paper towel and dab out the excess paint, try to get as much up as possible.

Then take warm water and a little bit of Dawn dish soap, mix in a sprayer, and spray the spot and dab. If you own a wet/dry vac, you can use this in place of the towel. Depending on how much paint was spilled, this can take some time to clean off the carpet, but continue to apply the cleaning agent and dab with a white towel or vacuum until all paint is gone. Sometimes you might need a solvent to fully remove the paint.
